what: The quote is word for word but cut short. S01-SH-022 (S01-SH-C031: https://www.shopify.com/legal/terms-shopify-payments, "Part I, B. Verification and Underwriting", read 2026-10-10; capture evidence/product-class/runs/20261012T104936Z-s01-sources/items/119-shopify.com/text.txt line 226): "The Payment Processors may hold funds in your Shopify Payments Account while awaiting the information requested above." The record drops the condition: a hold while verification information is awaited. The variant's other statement is conditional too: after termination "a Payment Processor may elect to continue to hold any funds deemed necessary, pending resolution of any other terms or obligations" (S01-SH-033, Part I, D. Effects of Termination, line 294). "Elsewhere" leaves out the scopes the sources give. S01-SH-099 (S01-SH-C160: help.shopify.com/en/manual/international/managed-markets/overview.md, "Flow of funds", read 2026-10-10; items/028-help.shopify.com/text.txt line 59), scope international Managed Markets orders: "Global-e holds the funds to remit the costs to proper authorities that are involved in the cross-border commerce transaction."; the same page, line 7: "Managed Markets is available to businesses based in the continental United States, and to certain stores in Canada and the United Kingdom." S01-SH-127 (S01-SH-C312: https://www.adyen.com/legal/adyen-for-platforms-terms-and-conditions, "2.6 Settlement", 2025-10; items/105-adyen.com/text.txt line 283): "No interest will be due over amounts held by Processor prior to Settlement of such funds to User", scope Adyen N.V. as Payment Processor (Payment Processor List, C. EMEA rows naming Adyen N.V.) and as Acquirer (Part II: EU / EEA; United Kingdom).
fix: - **Shopify:** "The Payment Processors may hold funds in your Shopify Payments Account while awaiting the information requested above" (S01-V-003). On international Managed Markets orders, available to businesses based in the continental US and to certain stores in Canada and the UK, "Global-e holds the funds to remit the costs to proper authorities that are involved in the cross-border commerce transaction" (S01-V-001). Where Adyen N.V. is the Payment Processor (the Payment Processor List's EMEA rows; the EU / EEA and UK terms), its terms speak of "amounts held by Processor prior to Settlement of such funds to User" (S01-V-006).

what: The quote and the pooled accounts hold. S01-WC-109 (S01-WC-C128: https://stripe.com/legal/ssa-service-terms, "Stripe Financial Services Terms: 3.1 Holding of Funds.", 2026-09-28; capture evidence/product-class/runs/20261012T104936Z-s01-sources/items/078-stripe.com/text.txt line 114): "Unless stated otherwise in Service Terms, Stripe will own, and User will not receive, any interest earned on funds held by Stripe or an applicable Affiliate." S01-WC-120 (S01-WC-C148, "Stripe Payments: 4.2 Pooled Accounts.", line 554): "All settlement funds Stripe receives for Transactions are combined with settlement funds for other users and held in one or more Pooled Accounts at one or more Financial Providers." But "with the WooPayments balance in front of them" adds a link that no cited source gives. S01-V-015's statements say only that "Money that you’ve made with WooPayments must flow through your WooPayments account balance before it’s paid out into your bank account" (S01-WC-024, S01-WC-C024: https://woocommerce.com/document/woopayments/payouts/payout-schedule/, 2026-08-21; items/099-woocommerce.com/text.txt line 39) and that "the payment amount (minus our fees) will be added to your account balance" (S01-WC-023, 2024-11-14; items/096-woocommerce.com/text.txt line 39). None of them names Stripe or its pooled accounts, and Stripe's 4.2 (line 554) speaks of "User’s Stripe Account balance", not a WooPayments balance.
fix: - **WooCommerce:** Stripe's terms speak of "funds held by Stripe or an applicable Affiliate" (S01-V-008), with settlement funds "combined with settlement funds for other users and held in one or more Pooled Accounts at one or more Financial Providers" (S01-V-011); money made with WooPayments "must flow through your WooPayments account balance before it’s paid out into your bank account" (S01-V-015).

what: The sources say less than "its payments": "PayPal powers the payment processing behind the scenes through your linked PayPal account, but all transactions made through BigCommerce Payments flow through your new BigCommerce Payments account for simplified management." (S01-BC-051, S01-BC-C068: https://www.bigcommerce.com/blog/bigcommerce-payments-announcement/, "Payments and your store, finally in one place", 2026-03-31; capture evidence/product-class/runs/20261013T003518Z-s01-a2-sources/items/006-bigcommerce.com/text.txt line 253, where line 247 offers it "for US customers on Core, Growth, and Scale plans"; S01-BC-055, S01-BC-C073: https://www.bigcommerce.com/blog/bigcommerce-payments-uk-expansion/, 2026-10-06; items/007-bigcommerce.com/text.txt line 259, scope "UK and EMEA customers on Core, Growth, and Scale plans", line 245). The record leaves out the product (transactions made through BigCommerce Payments, processed by PayPal through the linked PayPal account), the places (US; UK and EMEA) and the plans (Core, Growth, Scale). S01-BC-072 and S01-BC-084 (evidence/product-class/runs/20261013T053949Z-s01-bigcommerce-help-founder-machine/items/001-support.bigcommerce.com/text.txt lines 302 and 643) name the same account's balance.
fix: - with BigCommerce Payments, for US customers (blog of 31 March 2026) and UK and EMEA customers (blog of 6 October 2026) on Core, Growth and Scale plans, "PayPal powers the payment processing behind the scenes through your linked PayPal account, but all transactions made through BigCommerce Payments flow through your new BigCommerce Payments account" (S01-V-027);

what: Word for word.
